chunks: He said: Abul Hasan Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi, may Allah have mercy on him, reported to me, saying: al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Dallal narrated to us, saying: Ismail ibn Muhammad al-Muzni narrated to us, saying: Uthman ibn Saeed narrated to us, saying: Abul Hasan al-Tamimi narrated to us, from Sabrah ibn Ziyad, from al-Hakam ibn Utaibah, from Hanash ibn al-Mu'tamir, who said:

I once visited the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, and said: "Peace be upon you, O Commander of the Faithful, and the mercy of God and His blessings. How are you this evening?"

He said: "I spend the evening loving those who love us, and hating those who hate us. And our friend spends the evening rejoicing in a mercy from God that he had been expecting. And our enemy spends the evening founding his edifice on the crumbling brink of a hollow, and that brink has collapsed with him into the fire of Hell. The gates of Paradise have been opened for those who deserve them. So happiness for the people of mercy - theirs is their mercy! And ruination for the people of the Fire, and the Fire is for them!

O Hanash, whoever wishes to know whether he is our lover or our hater, let him examine his heart. If he loves our partisans, then he is not our hater. And if he hates our partisans, then he is not our lover. Indeed, God the Exalted has taken a covenant with our lovers for our friendship, and has written in the Record the names of those who hate us. We are the noble ones, and our ancestors are the ancestors of the Prophets."

key_terms.النجباء: The noble ones - an epithet the Imam applies to Ahlul Bayt
key_terms.شفا جرف هار: Crumbling brink of a hollow - Quranic imagery (9:109) symbolizing the unstable foundation of enemies
key_terms.محب/مبغض: Lover/hater - the central dichotomy regarding allegiance to Ahlul Bayt
key_terms.ميثاق: Covenant - a divine pact between God and the lovers of Ahlul Bayt
key_terms.ولينا: Our friend/partisan - referring to allies of Ahlul Bayt

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about loving and hating Ahlul Bayt?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Amali of al-Mufid, Hanash ibn al-Mu'tamir visits Imam Ali (AS) and greets him. The Imam responds with a powerful statement distinguishing lovers of Ahlul Bayt from their enemies, using Quranic imagery of building on a crumbling cliff (9:109). He advises that one can test their true loyalty by examining whom they love and hate among the Imam's partisans, and affirms that God has a covenant with those who love them while the names of their adversaries are already recorded.
word_analysis: may He have mercy on him

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 4. He said: Abul Hasan ‘Ali ibn Khalid al-Maraghi, may Allah bless him with mercy, reported to me from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad al-Dallal, who reported from Ismail ibn Muhammad al-Muzni, who reported from Uthman ibn Saeed, who reported from Abul Hasan al-Tameemi, from Sabrah ibn Ziyad, from al-Hakam ibn Utaibah, from Hanash ibn al-Mo’tamar, who said:
I once called upon Amirul Mu’mineen, ‘Ali ibn Abi Talib, peace be upon him, and said: "Salaam upon you, O Amirul Mu’mineen and His mercy and blessing, how are you?

He said: "I am in a state of loving those who love us, and hatred for those who hate us. And our friends are in a state of rejoicing in the mercy of Allah which they were expecting and our enemies are in a state of founding their edifice on the crumbling brink and that brink will fall down with him into the fire of hell. The gates of Paradise are opened for those who belong to it. So happiness and delight for the people who have earned their mercy of Allah, and ruination be for those who are in hell.

O Hanash, whoever wishes to know whether he is our lover or not, he should search his own heart. If he loves our friend and partisans, then he is not our enemy, but if he hates our friends and partisans, then he is not our lover. Allah has a covenant with our lovers for our friendship, and has written the names of our adversaries in the record. We are the ones of noble descent, and our ancestors are the ancestors of the Prophets."
